verdict.rationale: Mirrors compares live sessions that received a context change against holdout groups, using outcomes your team tracks (labels, checks, customer feedback). A recorded session shows "3 of 4 checks passed", which implies checks run on real sessions. However, the success signals are team-supplied, and nothing describes Mirrors running evaluators continuously on production traffic as a general capability. Missing for 10: documented continuous or online evaluator execution on live traffic, evaluator configuration and scoring docs, sampling and alerting on production evals, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
